ENGLISH: The Persians have been decisively crushed. Tales of our brutality are now spreading across the Orient. Rumors of cavalry running down soldiers, soldiers looting and burning cities and towns, and our mighty Khan sitting atop a throne made out of the skulls of his enemies. The viscious subjugation of Persia has made our Khan infamous, yet few know his name. Those who do know it dare not speak it, worrying that it might summon him. Instead, a nickname has spread like wildfire across the Islamic world...
